name: Koizuka Mana
source:
"I belong to you. And you belong to me."

[url=/c45359]Makoto's[/url] fiancée, who grew up in the same village as him. Her Kotodama power is among the strongest in the tribe. She loves [url=/c45359]Makoto[/url] dearly, but deep down she's a little sadistic -- making [url=/c45359]Makoto[/url] squirm is one of her favorite things.


Special skills: Messing with [url=/c45359]Makoto[/url]
Hobbies: Seducing [url=/c45359]Makoto[/url], reading shoujo manga (in silence)
Likes: [url=/c45359]Makoto[/url], birds, conversation (not good at speaking but likes to listen)
Dislikes: People from outside the village, noise, cars

[Based on translation from the [url=http://www.purplesoftware.jp/products/amatsutsumi/#prettyPhoto]Developer's Site[/url]]
